messages:
Vera: quick heads-up — after we merged spill-aware packer v3 at 02:06 us-west1c, tiny-infer tail latency spiked. many 1GPU pods Pending then Preempted.
Owen: dump of recent events shows `FailedAttach` followed by `Preempted` for the tiny pods. warmpool count collapsed from ~130 -> 22 in ~18m.
Priya: spill-aware packer v3 was supposed to avoid hot racks by spilling excess long-seq work, but telemetry shows it created concentrated NVLink lanes instead. suspect an autoscaler edge-case too: warmpool autoscaler didn't scale up because minSize override metric read 0.
infra-bot: ALERT: us-west1c warmpool depletion threshold breached at 8790012462. affected pods: 102 small-gpu inference; preemptions: 211.
Carlos: interesting — I see the autoscaler reading of `baselineCapacity` came back empty during the rollout due to a config key rename in the CRD. autoscaler treated baseline as 0 and didn't add capacity. that explains why packer pressure drained the warm pool fast.
Owen: two fast mitigations: 1) revert packer v3 (disruptive, takes ~10m) 2) patch warmpool CR to set `spec.minSize` to safe baseline (fast). also can deploy an admission mutator to label tiny pods `inference.latency=high`.
Priya: mutator ready to go — it will label pods where `resources.limits.nvidia.com/gpu == 1 && annotations['seq_len'] < "512"`. that'll bias scheduler to prefer warm nodes.
SRE Oncall: plan: Carlos patches warmpool min to baseline+30, Priya deploys mutator, Owen holds packer rollback until we observe effect. NetOps to check attach latencies on racks with high conntrack.
Carlos: applying patch now: `kubectl -n infra patch warmpool us-west1c -p '{"spec":{"minSize":170}}'` — applied at 8790012490.
infra-bot: ACTION: warmpool.minSize updated at 8790012490.
Priya: mutator applied at 8790012502. rule snippet: `if pod.gpu==1 and int(pod.annotations.get('seq_len','0')) < 512: pod.labels['inference.latency']='true'`.
Owen: early signals: pending queue dropping, small pods getting scheduled to warm nodes. nvlink error logs falling. but NetOps shows racks r3 and r4 still have attach timeouts due to conntrack backlog.
NetOps: starting a soft drain on r3 to rehab conntrack and rotate flows. ETA ~18m. there are some pods that were already bounced multiple times — they keep missing attach windows and get preempted on reschedule.
Vera: can we add a short attach-backoff for latency-tagged pods so they don't reschedule immediately? that will reduce bounce loops.
SRE Oncall: agreed. follow-ups: 1) implement `attach_retry_backoff` for pods labeled `inference.latency` 2) fix autoscaler CRD rename bug in warmpool controller and add canary check before packer rollouts 3) add per-rack `seq_len_concentration` metric and an alert when >60% long-seq on a rack 4) make `nvlink` a topology hint not a hard affinity in packer.
Carlos: opening a hotfix PR for autoscaler and a test to ensure baselineCapacity read works: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/9876.
Priya: opening PR for mutator to be toggleable per-AZ and adding e2e test: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/9880.
Owen: if we still see pressure after NetOps drain, we rollback packer v3. for now metrics look promising — pending queue down ~70% and preempt rate trending toward baseline.
infra-bot: RESOLVED: warmpool depletion cleared at 8790012678.
Vera: thanks team. I'll file an incident ticket with traces, the autoscaler debug log, and a proposed packer canary gating checklist. adding runbook note: before any packer rollout that changes affinity, run a 30m canary and verify per-rack seq skew < 40%. :thumbsup:
